column3: MT 85:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; אָסַפְתָּ (“you withdrew”) is rendered “You have taken away.”
Close to the Hebrew; “break your anger with us” is rendered “cause Your anger toward us to cease.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְאֶל־ חֲסִידָיו (“his godly ones”) is rendered “His saints.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty and faithfulness” is rendered “Mercy and truth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “faithfulness” is rendered “Truth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “will make [a way] for his footsteps” is rendered “shall make His footsteps our pathway.”
